วิธีวิเคราะห์: เลือกช่วงต้นที่ผู้ติดเชื้: Method: take the early phase while cases are still few (5–60 people) and fit a straight line to ln(number infected) against day. The slope is the growth rate r, which is converted to R0 with the SEIR formula R0 ≈ (1 + r·3)(1 + r·7). The same method is used on real case data early in an outbreak. The fit starts only after at least 8 days of data, and it swings when numbers are small, so try restarting a few times and compare. The fitted value is usually lower than the evenly mixed value, because the people around a case have already been infected, so the infection spreads in clusters
